pairs.evidence: lib/music-clip/gemini.ts:1 The only model call in this context listens to audio for lyric timing, and every frame comes from a code-built three.js scene for a fictional music film, so no generated plate or factual claim exists to bind to evidence; a case-insensitive search of lib/music-clip for photoreal, testimonial, citation and factRef found nothing.

techniques.evidence: lib/music-clip/gemini.ts:1 No image model draws any pixel here, so there is no plate/vector split to route; Gemini returns lyric times only.
lib/music-clip/gpuShot.ts:5 The frames are code-rendered, stylised WebGL scenes, not generated photoreal capture, so they claim no camera.

lib/music-clip/boardShell.ts:2 The numbers on the boards (bpm, intensity, times) are measured analysis on operator decision boards, which are internal drafts. The technique exempts internal drafts and has nothing factual to cite.
lib/music-clip/treatments.ts:2 The characters are fiction in a music-video treatment, not presenters making first-person experience claims.

pairs.subject: evidence-bound-visuals
pairs.evidence: app/_landing/cosmos/engine/library.ts:75 The library is a treemap sized by item count, but a category whose count is unknown (null) is given the average area and small counts are raised to 20% of the average; when known and unknown counts are mixed, unknown tiles get the same visual authority as known ones and the areas stop being proportional (certainty and precision laundering).

techniques.evidence: app/_landing/cosmos/engine/library.ts:75 The null grade is dropped from the number label but not from the area mark. Today's registry data has every count null, so the tiles come out equal; the gap is latent and appears with mixed data.
app/_landing/cosmos/engine/library.ts:91 A count is shown only when the data supplies one; an unknown is never shown as 0 or invented.
app/_landing/cosmos/engine/library.ts:121 Numbers and labels are DOM text written by code over the art; tiles without key art are painted by the procedural raster, not a model.

app/_landing/cosmos/engine/carousel.ts:172 The slots name the product's own templates and presets, not real people or places. Real key art is still told apart from stylised illustration in the accessible name.
app/_landing/cosmos/engine/carousel.ts:208 The only arrows are prev/next navigation, which point rather than claim causation.

pairs.registryProposal: precision-limit-propagation could say outright that a size-encoded layout (a treemap or bubble) must not fill a missing magnitude with a placeholder such as the mean, because area is the claim even when the number label is withheld.
